# Vendor intake: Ledgerly Payroll

> Fictional sample for demonstration. Ledgerly, Inc. and every person named here are invented.

- **Requested by:** Finance and People Operations
- **Product:** Ledgerly Payroll, a SaaS payroll and tax-filing service
- **Business purpose:** replace our in-house payroll spreadsheets for 180 employees
- **Data the vendor will receive:** employee names, addresses, Social Security numbers, salaries and bank account numbers for direct deposit
- **Integration:** one-way sync from our HR system (new hires and terminations); SSO for 6 Finance and People staff
- **Criticality:** important; payroll must run on schedule, but a manual off-cycle run is possible for one cycle
- **Contract status:** standard order form and Data Processing Addendum under review
